Overlay, not a fork."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"A curated distribution of DeepSeek Harness."},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Overlay, not a fork."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness provides an excellent plugin framework and a conservative reference setup. `oh-my-d"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"sh` turns those building blocks into an opinionated coding environment: sensible profiles, inert reu"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"se of your existing MCP configuration, LSP navigation and recoverable semantic rename, upstream `@fi"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"le` discovery with anchored line-range snapshots, stale-safe editing, SSRF-hardened web fetch on by "},{"id":"p5s5","text":"default, optional DAP debugging, notifications, usage reporting, persistent code kernels, and approv"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"al-gated skill distillation that turns verified procedures into reusable skills."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"It is a native curated distribution, not a fork. You keep upstream's “everything is a plugin” archit"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ecture and can override every choice."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"> DeepSeek Harness is in developer preview. `oh-my-dsh` pins a tested upstream release instead of si"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"lently following breaking changes."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Capability tiers"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"OMD classifies every capability into one of four tiers:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Tier                     | Meaning                                                                "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"             | Examples                                                                             "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"                                   |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| **Core**                 | Ships in the artifact and is enabled by the default composition        "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"             | Upstream web/headless runtime, OMD first-party plugins, proposal controls, hardened w"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"eb fetch, bundled language servers |
| **Bundled optional**     | Ships in the closure but inert unt"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"il explicitly activated through the approval path | Curated plugin catalog: `dsh-skill-badge`, `dsh-"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"pkg-info`                                                               |
| **Curated integrations**"},{"id":"p11s6","text":" | Reviewed metadata, setup guidance, or skills; external runtime not in the base      | browser-use"},{"id":"p11s7","text":" CLI, Playwright MCP, Context7 — require separate installation and have their own network behavior  "},{"id":"p11s8","text":"         |
| **User growth**          | Lives outside the immutable base; survives update and rollba"},{"id":"p11s9","text":"ck                      | User skills, Plugin Forge output, local MCP definitions, forged plugins, t"},{"id":"p11s10","text":"rust decisions                                |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Features with external prerequisites are documented as curated integrations, not as "included" or "w"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"orks out of the box.""},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## What you get"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### Lazy MCP capability control"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Imported and preset MCP servers are catalogued without starting a process, expanding credentials, or"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" injecting tool schemas. The model can search server names and previously cached non-secret tool met"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"adata, then prepare an activation proposal. Only `proposal_control apply` starts that server for the"},{"id":"p15s4","text":" current agent session."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Useful controls:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- `/omd-mcp [query]` lists inert and active servers without activating them.
- `mcp_control` lists, "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"searches, and prepares activation or deactivation.
- `proposal_control` shows the command or URL pat"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"h, arguments with credential values redacted, working directory, and source config before applying w"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"ith user approval.
- Deactivation disposes the upstream MCP fiber and removes its tools."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### Capability discovery plane"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"`capability_search` is a read-only search surface over tools, skills, slash commands, inert or activ"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"e MCP servers, curated session plugins, and agent-forged plugins. Stable refs look like `tool:bash`,"},{"id":"p19s3","text":" `mcp:omd-playwright`, `plugin:dsh-skill-badge`, or `plugin:forged/user/<slug>`. Forged hits carry a"},{"id":"p19s4","text":" `forged` marker and route through `plugin_forge`, not `plugin_control`. Each hit returns status, su"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"mmary, provenance, and an exact next step. Discovery never starts an MCP process, imports a package,"},{"id":"p19s6","text":" expands credentials, or creates a proposal. Zero-hit searches are recorded as capability gaps. `/om"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"d-capabilities [query]` is the human-facing counterpart."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Security notes"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- `danger-full-access` is available but never the default. It still asks before committing a prepare"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"d proposal.
- Project integrations are gated by `omd trust`.
- MCP definitions do not start, expand "},{"id":"p21s3","text":"environment placeholders, or expose schemas during discovery. Expansion happens on the host only aft"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"er an approved activation and values never enter prompts or metadata caches.
- Semantic refactors re"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"ject edits outside the session workspace and recheck every observed file version before writing.
- O"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"nly explicit `@file:start-end` ranges are attached by OMD. They resolve only workspace files, stay b"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"ounded, and treat attached content as data rather than instructions; plain `@file` references attach"},{"id":"p21s8","text":" nothing.
- Web fetch blocks private, loopback, link-local, and cloud-metadata destinations both at "},{"id":"p21s9","text":"URL validation and at DNS-connect time (rebinding-safe). `OMD_WEB_FETCH_ALLOW_PRIVATE=1` removes tha"},{"id":"p21s10","text":"t guard; `DSH_WEB_FETCH_PROVIDER=http` selects upstream's provider, which has no such protection.
- "},{"id":"p21s11","text":"DAP debugging is off until `OMD_ENABLE_DEBUG=1`. Launch and attach still require an approved proposa"},{"id":"p21s12","text":"l; debuggee paths stay inside the workspace.
- Glob-scoped Cursor rules are not applied globally whe"},{"id":"p21s13","text":"n dsh cannot determine the active file.
- Persistent kernels execute as your host user. They require"},{"id":"p21s14","text":" approval by default and are not a sandbox.
- Monetary cost is not estimated because dsh does not ex"},{"id":"p21s15","text":"pose provider-neutral pricing."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| oh-my-dsh         | DeepSeek Harness (`@deepseek-ai/dsh*`) | Node.js / runtime                    "},{"id":"p23s2","text":"  | DeepSeek Harness (`@deepseek-ai/dsh*`) | Node.js / runtime                                     |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| main (unreleased) | `0.1.0-rc.8` (exact pin)               | Embedded (portable) or `^22.19.0 \|\|"},{"id":"p24s2","text":" >=24.0.0` (npm) |
| 0.1.7             | `0.1.0-rc.7` (exact pin)               | Embedded (portable"},{"id":"p24s3","text":") or `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` (npm) |
| 0.1.0–0.1.6       | `0.1.0-rc.6` (exact pin)               |"},{"id":"p24s4","text":" `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0`                              |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Upstream is in developer preview, so `oh-my-dsh` pins one tested release and never follows breaking "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"changes silently. A weekly canary workflow additionally tests the overlay against `dsh@next`, so an "},{"id":"p25s3","text":"incompatible upcoming release is filed as an issue before it ships. Upgrades follow docs/upstream-up"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"ing release is filed as an issue before it ships. Upgrades follow docs/upstream-upgrade-playbook.md."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The published package is a formal dsh bundle.
